To determine functional connectivity, we performed a whole brain psychophysiological interactions analysis (PPI; ) in FSL using seed regions in seven areas of the reward network based on a review by Filbey and Dewitt (2012): (1) nucleus accumbens (NAc), (2) orbitofrontal cortex (OFC), (3) ventral tegmental area (VTA), (4) insula, (5) hippocampus, (6) amygdala, and (7) anterior cingulate gyrus (ACG).

The 71 participants who had minimal movement in the scanner (i.e., <3 degrees rotation and 3 mm translation) and subsequently used in these analyses had a mean duration of marijuana use of 6.67 years (SD = 6.84), mean marijuana use occasions of 3.38 times per day (SD = 2.16) (based on the Cannabis History Questionnaire (CHQ)), and mean marijuana withdrawal checklist (MWC) score of 5.75 (SD = 4.68).
